newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe national cargo carrier grounds aircraft.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe national cargo carrier grounds aircraft.

text.p: Zimbabwe's state-owned national cargo airline, Affretair, has grounded its DC-8 aircraft because it no longer meets international civil aviation standards, the Zimbabwe Independent newspaper reported on Friday.

It quoted unnamed top officials at the airline as saying the move could mark the end of the road for Affretair unless the government guaranteed a U.S.$20 million loan for it to acquire a new aircraft from the United States.

"If Affretair were in private hands, without having to rely on government guarantees and without decisions about its operations having to be approved or made at cabinet -- where there is no record of expertise in civil aviation matters -- then Affretair would not have problems of sustaining itself due to its strategic role," one of the officials said.

Affretair officials were unavailable for further comment, but in June sales manager Phil Critchlow told Reuters the airline looked set to stay airborne despite financial and operational woes as well as increased competition in the industry.
